mapper.sql: (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECTAGG(g.name, r.spec_value) AS CHAR) FROM product_sku_spec_rel r LEFT JOIN product_spec_group g ON g.id = r.spec_group_id WHERE r.sku_id = s.id)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.price, s.stock, s.status, AS spec_json FROM product_sku s WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.price, s.stock, s.status, AS spec_json FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.sort ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND status = 1
UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId}
UPDATE products p SET p.stock = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1), p.update_time = NOW() WHERE p.id = #{productId}
